rules.name: Work In Progress Limit
rules.description: Team should not have too many tasks in Active state simultaneously

rules.name: Task Staleness
rules.description: Tasks should progress regularly — stale tasks indicate blockers or neglect

rules.name: Unassigned Tasks
rules.description: All active/new tasks MUST have an owner — no exceptions

rules.name: Sprint Completion Rate
rules.description: Sprint should show meaningful progress — high % of new/active means poor execution

rules.name: Excessive New/Unstarted Tasks
rules.description: Sprint should not have majority of tasks still in New state

rules.name: Workload Balance
rules.description: Work must be distributed — overloaded or idle members are both problems

rules.name: Task Aging (New State)
rules.description: New tasks must be picked up quickly — sitting in New is unacceptable

rules.name: Task Aging (Active State)
rules.description: Active tasks must complete — lingering Active = stalled work

rules.name: Unclear Task Titles
rules.description: Every task must have a clear, actionable title — vague titles signal poor planning

rules.name: Inactive Team Members
rules.description: Team members with zero tasks in active sprints indicate resource waste

rules.name: Scope Creep
rules.description: Tasks created after sprint start indicate poor planning or scope creep

rules.name: Carry-Over from Previous Sprint
rules.description: Excessive carry-over means the previous sprint failed to complete

rules.name: Single Person Dependency
rules.description: One person carrying >50% of sprint tasks is a bus factor risk

A.label: A — Excellent
A.description: Sprint is healthy, on track, well-executed
